largest_gap: Mobile re-staging: fixed-height monitor regions cut the PARADOX SYNC rule and the archive schematic was covered by its footer action bar.

findings.observation: The mechanic block was cut mid-sentence by the panel bottom; the only sign of more content was a 2px inner scrollbar.
findings.consequence: On the sector that teaches synchronization, the rule itself was unreadable.
findings.repair: Reduced the synced-level stage height, shortened the rule to a fully visible two-line summary, and capped the causal log to one line in synced state.
findings.resolution: fixed and re-rendered; monitorScrollHeight equals clientHeight

findings.region: archive-mobile — fixed action bar over SCHEMATIC
findings.observation: The fixed bottom CTA sat on top of the map preview.
findings.consequence: The only sector preview looked clipped at first paint.
findings.repair: Archive mobile now uses a flex column with one scrolling main area and an in-flow footer action bar.
findings.resolution: fixed and re-rendered; main and footer do not overlap

findings.observation: Notifications covered the monitor headings and stat labels; fragments of labels peeked out at the viewport edge.
findings.consequence: Telemetry was hidden while numbers remained unlabeled.
findings.repair: Toast geometry was widened on desktop and clipped fringe text removed; full non-overlap requires a larger layout change.

findings.region: charge cluster — header / rail / command bar
findings.observation: The same resource was named CHARGE, ECHO CHARGE, and REWIND CAPACITY, and an empty meter could read as full.
findings.consequence: Resource remaining and identity were ambiguous.
findings.repair: Unified the name to ECHO CHARGE / 余响; empty meters are now outlined segmented slots.

findings.observation: Some sync chips were circles and some rectangles with no visible legend in the captured state.
findings.consequence: The row looked like a rendering inconsistency.
findings.repair: Kept the intentional circle-vs-square distinction for normal nodes vs mass cradles, and made the ○/□ legend persist in the latched and mobile states.

findings.observation: The first card looked pre-selected; the warning was tiny; the headline wrapped to a two-character orphan.
findings.repair: Neutral cards by default; warning moved above the cards and enlarged; desktop headline one line and mobile headline balanced manually.
